Poem of Creation (Enūma eliš) – Standard Babylonian V: “He Made Positions For The Great Gods”

20

  • N: in[a s]imti | šutakṣibam-ma || bini | arkāniš
  • T: “Wane at the same pace and form in reverse.

  • L: [iškun ← šakānu I “to put, place, lay down”; h]allīša ← hallu I “(upper) thigh O/jB, NA in du.”; retât ← retû II “to drive in, fix Bab., NA”; šamāmī ← šamāmū I “heavens Bab.(poet.) for šamû I”
  • Note: Ee V 61 is preserved only here and in HuzNA1, and the text differs slightly in both MSS. The version of this MS features an additional word (imitta) and may be translated as “[He placed] her [thig]hs on the right (?) as the braces of heaven”. The restoration of the first word of the line is a conjecture, for which see [RN1013: 100-101]. Due to the poor state of preservation, it is difficult to decide, whether the first to signs of re!#-ta!#-ti# are written over an erasure ([fromebllab0038: 95]).
